scope: FP-04 Step 7 — Settings (check-ins): section labels, hints, validation messages, and the R-4 notification warning.

strings.section_intro: How often Davos checks in, and when.
strings.cadence_hint: Each check-in asks about the interval that just ended.
strings.active_hours_hint: Check-ins are only scheduled inside these hours. The end must come after the start — Davos does not schedule overnight.
strings.notifications_ask_hint: Davos needs notification permission to deliver check-ins.
strings.notifications_denied_hint: Check-ins and accountability depend on notifications. With them off, Davos cannot prompt you — and it will still notice the windows you missed.
strings.notifications_web: On the web, check-ins appear as an in-app banner instead of a notification.
strings.error_hours_order: Active hours must end after they start.
strings.error_save: Couldn't save your check-in settings. Try again.
